blocks.orig: And if you want to spend less time travelling and more time exploring, you can turn your safari into a flying safari – exclusivity galore. By private plane you’ll go from one Tanzanian highlight to the next, adding a special spark to your East African safari experience.
blocks.html: If you would rather spend less time on the move and more time discovering, your safari can become a flying safari – exclusivity in abundance. A private plane carries you from one Tanzanian highlight to another, giving your East African safari an extra sparkle.

blocks.orig: During your private travel you have the chance to meet very special people. Tanzania is one of the most culturally diverse countries in the world with more than 120 ethnic groups living here. The most famous are, of course, the Maasai who have sparked people’s interest for centuries. Visit them, or tribes like the Hadzabe Bushmen, the Chaga farmers or the Nyamwezi, in their homes and catch an exclusive glimpse of their everyday life, traditions and ancient customs.
blocks.html: Travelling privately also gives you the opportunity to meet some remarkable people. With more than 120 ethnic groups, Tanzania ranks among the most culturally diverse countries in the world. Best known are naturally the Maasai, who have fascinated people for centuries. You can visit them, or groups such as the Hadzabe Bushmen, the Chaga farmers or the Nyamwezi, at home and get a rare look at their daily life, traditions and age-old customs.

blocks.orig: After some exciting and unforgettable days during your safari in the savannah, you can relax in a luxurious five star all-inclusive resort on Zanzibar.
blocks.html: Once you have enjoyed a few thrilling, memorable days on safari in the savannah, you can unwind at a luxurious five-star all-inclusive resort on Zanzibar.

blocks.orig: Imagine having your feet in the warm, pearly white sand during dinner while the sun is setting on the horizon. Or waking up to the splashing waves of the Indian Ocean right in front of your doorstep. Or relaxing in a hammock underneath the palm trees with a cocktail in your hand.
blocks.html: Picture yourself at dinner with your toes in warm, pearly white sand as the sun sinks below the horizon. Or waking to the sound of Indian Ocean waves lapping just outside your door. Or lazing in a hammock beneath the palms, cocktail in hand.

blocks.orig: To be honest, it doesn’t really matter how you’re going to spend your days on Zanzibar: here you’ll feel like you’re in heaven and get spoilt with a gorgeous flora and fauna, culinary highlights and luxury at its best.
